mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies and a comfortable 71 degrees at Harriet Park. The temperature will head down to an overnight low of 63 degrees with no rain predicted for the rest of the evening.

In city news, the Verona Police Department has updated their records process to be more efficient, allowing you to obtain crash reports online. Also, keep an eye out for road surface treatments starting on Lincoln Street and surrounding areas between August 4 and 7.

Today is packed with activities including the Remote Area Medical Clinic at the high school, the Sugar River Paddle and Jamboree, and the Dane County Farmers Market in Madison. Coming up, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus on Tuesday and Paddy Mac's on Tuesday night.
Checking in on the weekly police report, on July 23, officers responded to a disturbance on Lucerne Drive where a 23-year-old man was arrested for disorderly conduct and intimidation of a victim.

Today is the perfect time to visit Culver's for their delicious Chocolate Volcano flavor. They are open until 10:30 PM, so there is plenty of time to head over. You can also find a Kona Ice truck at Fireman's Park today from 1:30 PM to 3:15 PM.
